name: cosmos-sources-tools
description: Fetch, verify, and locally archive daily source content from CLS, Knowledge Planet, DingTalk, and Feishu.

interface.shortDescription: Archive daily CLS, Knowledge Planet, DingTalk, and Feishu content.
interface.longDescription: Retrieves and semantically filters the complete China Standard Time CLS telegraph feed, archives every topic and attachment from one Knowledge Planet Beijing calendar day through signed-in Chrome, or reads exact DingTalk and Feishu groups through signed-in desktop sessions. All four skills write source-grounded local Markdown without introducing external model credentials.
defaultPrompt: Fetch and filter today's AI-related CLS telegraph feed.
Archive every topic and attachment from a Knowledge Planet for one Beijing calendar date.
Filter today's messages from exact DingTalk or Feishu groups into source-faithful Markdown.
